title: I payed someone to make a game for me!!!!!!!
author: Responsible-Yam-9475
selftext:
please compliment how good *my* work is, I described what I wanted and they made it!!!! NO WAY I'M SO SKILLFUL!!!!!!!!! WHOOHOOOOO.

It has all the furries and cat girls you could possibly want!

  
Please don't be mean about ***my*** work

comments.body: Ah, so you paid your fursona

replies.body: No, I just described the game I wanted to someone, who made it for me. I thought this would be the right suB!!!! I really spent a long time THINKING about the description in the end I wrote: "make a fun game for me to play" I am a genius GAME DEVELOPER
